title: Transfer a loaded fixture pallet with a forked lifter
instruction: Use the forked lifter to move the loaded pallet onto the two green inspection rests. Withdraw and return the lifter to its supports, then open both grippers.
context: Inspectors position components for testing. Moving this small loaded fixture onto inspection rests requires inserting a shaped tool beneath it, maintaining contact support, seating the pallet and withdrawing the tool without gripping the workpiece.
setup: Calibrated YAM station; tabletop z=0.7475 m. A 120 g rigid pallet has a 120 x 160 x 6 mm plate, four 20 mm feet, central round blank and fasteners; root starts at (0.40,0.08,0.7705) m. An 80 g lifter has two 150 x 12 x 5 mm tines spaced 60 mm center-to-center, handle and rigid grip sleeve. It starts on supports at root (0.24,0.28,0.7825) m. Two 150 x 18 x 15 mm inspection rails are centered at x=0.37, y=-0.19 and -0.05 m. Mesh generators and exact poses are included. Intended physical materials: steel pallet plate, feet, fasteners and lifter; aluminium blank and inspection rails; rubber grip sleeve; rigid acetal tool supports; painted marks. Assigned simulation masses are independent of density; solid metal reproductions will be heavier.
scoring: Final score requires lifter-pallet contact and no invalid history; no historical lift-height minimum for seating. 0.75 if resting within 12 mm of (0.37,-0.12) m, bottom within 4 mm of the 15 mm rail height, orientation within 8 degrees and vertical extent below 42 mm. Full 1.0 also requires lifter parked flat on supports, both grippers over 75% open and TCPs over 90 mm from both loose objects. Otherwise 0.25 only while the whole pallet is above tabletop+15 mm; zero elsewhere. Robot-pallet contact, drops, nonfinite positions or leaving workspace permanently invalidate. Success held 1 second.
reset_notes: Fixed seed 0, zero jitter. Restore pallet, lifter and arms; clear contact and lift history; settle physics. Nothing consumed.
fidelity: Rigid lifter and loaded pallet with compound primitive contact geometry. The pallet is supported by friction/contact only; no attachments, pose writes or payload animation. Loose-object solver 32/4, contact/rest offsets 0.5/0 mm; robot unchanged. Lightweight training masses, friction and material looks are approximate and uncalibrated. Scripted demo uses privileged pose feedback.
scores: Revised scorer: low-clearance scripted demo 1.0 in 997 actions (success); matching Dream-1 beta 0 in 1800 actions (max_steps). Demo telemetry audited; both runs have sampled montage review. Linked media show these revised runs.
